purpose: Teach: 断ら/就い/傘下/綿密/総論/凝らし/辛抱/リストアップ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、無理な依頼は断られても問題ない、と社員に伝えろ
lines.en: Tell the staff that if an unreasonable request gets turned down, that is not a problem.
lines.style: Flat, clipped command; every word placed deliberately, no warmth spent, firm final landing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新部長が役職に就いた事を社内で告知します
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll announce internally that the new department head has taken up his post.
lines.style: Prompt, bright acknowledgment; brisk businesslike pace with a clean, confident close.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、子会社、つまり傘下企業の業績を月次で確認しろ
lines.en: Check the results of our subsidiaries — the companies under our umbrella — every month.
lines.style: Low and level; slows slightly to spell out the clarification, then snaps the order shut.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品の設計を綿密に見直します
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll go over the new product's design meticulously.
lines.style: Quick affirmative attack, then steady methodical rhythm, ticking the task off aloud.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社長挨拶では総論から各論へ流せ
lines.en: For the president's address, flow from the general overview into the specifics.
lines.style: Measured instruction with a hint of impatience; even stress, expecting immediate understanding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。展示ブースに工夫を凝らしたデザインを採用します
lines.en: Yes, sir. We'll go with a carefully crafted design for the exhibition booth.
lines.style: Crisp and cooperative; a touch of pride creeping in on the design detail.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新人の辛抱強さを評価しろ
lines.en: And make sure the new hires' perseverance gets recognized in their evaluations.
lines.style: Quieter but firmer; a rare note of approval buried under the flat directive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。優秀社員をリストアップして報告します
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll draw up a list of our top employees and report back.
lines.style: Snappy wrap-up energy; efficient pace, slight upward lift signaling the meeting is done.
